origin.description: Run code with a package name on the search path.

arguments.name: code
arguments.text: Callable run while the package name is attached.

origin.details: A package that is already attached is left in place and is not detached afterwards.
origin.example:
was <- "package:compiler" %in% search()
during <- with_package("compiler", "package:compiler" %in% search())
after <- "package:compiler" %in% search()
c(if (isTRUE(during)) "TRUE" else "FALSE", if (after == was) "restored" else "open")

translation.description: Run code with a package name on the search path.

arguments.name: code
arguments.text: Callable run while the package name is attached.

translation.details: A package that is already attached is left in place and is not detached afterwards. code is a callable, and local_* is a context manager.
translation.example:
import os
import tempfile
from withr import *

was = "package:compiler" in search()
during = with_package("compiler", lambda: "package:compiler" in search())
after = "package:compiler" in search()
return ["TRUE" if during else "FALSE", "restored" if after == was else "open"]
